say:1:1660209001:1.text: After what feels like forever tumbling through the dark, you both land with a muffled thump on soft, golden sand.
say:1:1660209001:1.source_cn: 在黑暗中不知掉落了多久，“嗵”地一声，你和柳博米尔落在...
say:1:1660209001:1.male: After what feels like forever tumbling through the dark, you both land with a muffled thump on soft, golden sand.
say:1:1660209001:1.female: After what feels like forever tumbling through the dark, you both land with a muffled thump on soft, golden sand.

say:2:1660209002:2.text: You look down at your hands. The petal is gone. In its place is a piece of sheet music—the Song of Spring.
say:2:1660209002:2.source_cn: 你第一时间看向手中的花瓣，它变成了一张乐谱，是《春日之歌》。
say:2:1660209002:2.male: You look down at your hands. The petal is gone. In its place is a piece of sheet music—the Song of Spring.
say:2:1660209002:2.female: You look down at your hands. The petal is gone. In its place is a piece of sheet music—the Song of Spring.

say:4:1660209003:0.text: Ludovic recalls what happened in the dream and can't help but let out a wry smile.
say:4:1660209003:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔回想起刚才梦境里中的情节，不由得苦笑。

say:5:1660209004:0.text: This curse knows precisely where to strike... it goes straight for the weakest parts of you. Even I wasn't ready for it.
say:5:1660209004:0.source_cn: 在人内心最脆弱的地方扎根……这诅咒的滋味，即便对我来说...
say:5:1660209004:0.male: This curse knows precisely where to strike... it goes straight for the weakest parts of you. Even I wasn't ready for it.
say:5:1660209004:0.female: This curse knows precisely where to strike... it goes straight for the weakest parts of you. Even I wasn't ready for it.

say:6:1660209005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you... for everything you've done. I was out of line earlier. Please forgive me.
say:6:1660209005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you... for everything you've done. I was out of line earlier. Please forgive me.
say:6:1660209005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you... for everything you've done. I was out of line earlier. Please forgive me.

say:7:1660209006:1.text: You understand why. That illness upended Ludovic's whole life. Time may have passed, but to him, that pain is still as fresh as ever.
say:7:1660209006:1.source_cn: 你非常理解柳博米尔的心情，那场疾病改变了柳博米尔的一切...
say:7:1660209006:1.male: You understand why. That illness upended Ludovic's whole life. Time may have passed, but to him, that pain is still as fresh as ever.
say:7:1660209006:1.female: You understand why. That illness upended Ludovic's whole life. Time may have passed, but to him, that pain is still as fresh as ever.

say:8:1660209007:1.text: You remind him that this is just a dream. None of it can touch him anymore.
say:8:1660209007:1.source_cn: 你安慰柳博米尔，这一切只是一场梦境。
say:8:1660209007:1.male: You remind him that this is just a dream. None of it can touch him anymore.
say:8:1660209007:1.female: You remind him that this is just a dream. None of it can touch him anymore.

say:9:1660209008:1.text: A dream... and yet it feels more real than reality. Whoever made this dream has power that rivals the gods.
say:9:1660209008:1.source_cn: 梦……不可思议的梦境，如此真实而又细腻，这种力量，堪比神明。
say:9:1660209008:1.male: A dream... and yet it feels more real than reality. Whoever made this dream has power that rivals the gods.
say:9:1660209008:1.female: A dream... and yet it feels more real than reality. Whoever made this dream has power that rivals the gods.

say:10:1660209009:1.text: Still, the way it mirrors my past... it's too precise. And it can't be a coincidence.
say:10:1660209009:1.source_cn: 不过，梦境里的内容与我的过去太过相似，这并非一种巧合。
say:10:1660209009:1.male: Still, the way it mirrors my past... it's too precise. And it can't be a coincidence.
say:10:1660209009:1.female: Still, the way it mirrors my past... it's too precise. And it can't be a coincidence.

say:11:1660209010:1.text: You agree with Ludovic. These dreams seem to be specifically created from someone's memories.
say:11:1660209010:1.source_cn: 你十分赞同柳博米尔的看法，这些梦境，应该就是根据人们经...
say:11:1660209010:1.male: You agree with Ludovic. These dreams seem to be specifically created from someone's memories.
say:11:1660209010:1.female: You agree with Ludovic. These dreams seem to be specifically created from someone's memories.

say:12:1660209011:1.text: You have to find whoever is crafting these dreams. It's the only way to stop this curse.
say:12:1660209011:1.source_cn: 只有找到生成梦境的人，才能对症下药，解除诅咒。
say:12:1660209011:1.male: You have to find whoever is crafting these dreams. It's the only way to stop this curse.
say:12:1660209011:1.female: You have to find whoever is crafting these dreams. It's the only way to stop this curse.

say:13:1660209012:1.text: We've got friends trapped by the curse, and nightmares wearing their faces. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, maybe you're the only one who can tell them apart.

say:13:1660209012:1.female: We've got friends trapped by the curse, and nightmares wearing their faces. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, maybe you're the only one who can tell them apart.

say:15:1660209013:1.text: You've crossed paths with so many in Esperia. You know their stories well, and you know what it'll take to bring them back.
say:15:1660209013:1.source_cn: 你在伊索米亚交游甚广，只有你最了解他们的故事，明白该如...
say:15:1660209013:1.male: You've crossed paths with so many in Esperia. You know their stories well, and you know what it'll take to bring them back.
say:15:1660209013:1.female: You've crossed paths with so many in Esperia. You know their stories well, and you know what it'll take to bring them back.

say:16:1660209014:1.text: If anyone can do it, Merlin... it's you...
say:16:1660209014:1.source_cn: 我想，没有人比“梅林”更适合做这件事了……
say:16:1660209014:1.male: If anyone can do it, Merlin... it's you...
say:16:1660209014:1.female: If anyone can do it, Merlin... it's you...

say:17:1660209015:1.text: Before Ludovic can finish, a burst of cheerful music and laughter drifts in from behind the rocks and trees.
say:17:1660209015:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔话音未落，突然一阵欢快的曲调，伴着人声，从树丛...

say:18:1660209016:1.text: Looks like the next dream is beginning.
say:18:1660209016:1.source_cn: 看来，新的梦境要开始了。
say:18:1660209016:1.male: Looks like the next dream is beginning.
say:18:1660209016:1.female: Looks like the next dream is beginning.

say:19:1660209017:1.text: You and Ludovic make your way toward the sound.
say:19:1660209017:1.source_cn: 你和柳博米尔一道，向着声音传来的方向走去。
say:19:1660209017:1.male: You and Ludovic make your way toward the sound.
say:19:1660209017:1.female: You and Ludovic make your way toward the sound.

choice:14:1:2.text: Of course! They're all my friends!
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 对啊，他们都是我的朋友！
choice:14:1:2.male: Of course! They're all my friends!
choice:14:1:2.female: Of course! They're all my friends!
